copy.headline: Arlington pastor convicted for "classic Ponzi scheme"
copy.caption:
WATCH: Arlington pastor convicted for "classic Ponzi scheme"

An Arlington pastor could face up to 20 years in prison after he was convicted for defrauding followers out of over $6 million dollars.

Video: FOX 4 Dallas-Fort Worth on YouTube
